result_vintage: AEP centralised results published on data.gov.ro (file timestamp 14 December 2016); not the Central Electoral Bureau final act
turnout_definition: Not established: the AEP files carry count columns a–g without an accepted official definition, so registered voters, voters and turnout are not published. Valid votes are proven as the sum of all list and independent votes (column e plus postal d1).
